description: Adoption flattens notes/agents.md to content/concepts/agents.md and keeps the body byte for byte (AGSC-02-90), so its relative references stop resolving. `init` reports each broken reference as the warning AGSC-E507 naming the reference, copies each referenced local file under the adoption root to content/assets/<original-relative-path>, and leaves alone an absolute URL, a fragment and a path escaping the adoption root (AGSC-02-95). The warnings do not make adoption fail; but the references are still broken, so the next `ci` — after the publisher adds the security contact — reports each as the error AGSC-E310 and exits 1 until the publisher repairs them (AGSC-02-95, AGSC-03-11). Run with the real verbs. Supersedes adopt-0005.
